'''MX-T4''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] they directed Republic troops to the [[Legislature Building]].
